profile.headline: Software Engineer at Kryptowire
profile.summary: Experienced Technical Consultant skilled in C++,Java, Database Management, Customer Service, and Microsoft Office. Strong information technology professional with a Bachelor of Information Technology & Management from Illinois Institute of Technology and Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Engineering from Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and develop custom software applications and updates/enhancements to existing applications that meet the needs of the university and support the university's web and mobile needs. 

Analyze user needs/software requirements by meeting with colleges and departments and develop software solutions to meet those needs.

Develop testing procedures, test plans, and technical documentation for new/modified software to ensure performance, security, and interoperability with operating system, integrated services, and other applications and identify/troubleshoot solutions to any issues. 

Develop application deployment and support strategies for departmental and enterprise-wide applications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop software to detect vulnerabilities in mobile application software as outlined in National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) and National Information Assurance Partnership (NIAP) security standards.
• Research emerging trends in mobile application security, malware, and mobile application security testing tools.
• Develop software to integrate mobile security analysis tools with third-party security technologies.
• Prepare data for research papers to be submitted to security conferences.
• Present research findings and new areas of research during quarterly engineering
team meetings.
• Design, build and implement web-based products as directed by management needs.
